title: University of Otago City of Literature PhD Scholarship
field: Literature (PhD research on a topic relevant to literature)

compensation.value: NZ$34,128 stipend per annum plus domestic tuition fee waiver (excludes student services fee)
compensation.evidence_quote: NZ $34,128 stipend per annum (PhD) plus domestic tuition fee waiver (excludes student services fee)

about: Annual University of Otago scholarship for one PhD candidate researching literature, marking Dunedin's UNESCO City of Literature status. It provides a NZ$34,128 yearly stipend plus a domestic tuition fee waiver. Applications close 31 January.
requirements: Graduates in any discipline intending to undertake PhD research on a topic relevant to literature
Applicants must be obtaining their first doctoral qualification
Offered annually to support one PhD candidate; applications reviewed after 31 January each year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD research on a topic relevant to literature" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Applicants must be obtaining their first doctoral qualification" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
